info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Pyrite Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Manage Pyrite Pendant Details API enables the creation and management of detailed information for pyrite pendant products within the catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to establish product attributes, descriptions, and other essential details to enrich their inventory offerings. It's particularly useful for e-commerce platforms and retailers looking to enhance their product information and provide a comprehensive buyer experience. Use this API to streamline the addition of new pyrite pendant items into your catalog efficiently.

post.summary: Create details for a pyrite pendant.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create detailed information for a pyrite pendant. Providing detailed metadata can enhance the overall presentation and accessibility of the pendant in various platforms.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the details for the Pyrite pendant. This includes all necessary fields specified in the schema, which define the attributes and properties of the pendant being requested.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the details of the pyrite pendant.

CreateCatalogPyritePendantDetailRequest.title: Pyrite Pendant Details Request

pyrite_pendant_id.description: Unique identifier for the pyrite pendant.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person who requested the pyrite pendant.

quantity.description: The number of pyrite pendants requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the pyrite pendant.

CreateCatalogPyritePendantDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating or updating pyrite pendant details.

CreateCatalogPyritePendantDetailResponse.title: Pyrite Pendant Details Operation Response

status.description: Indicates the status of the operation performed.

recordId.description: Unique identifier for the recorded entry after processing.

processedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the processing was completed.

matchedCount.description: Count of records that matched the criteria during the operation.

CreateCatalogPyritePendantDetailResponse.description: Response schema for the operations related to pyrite pendant details. This schema contains information regarding the status of the operation, the record ID of the processed item, the timestamp of when the operation was processed, and the count of matched records.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource. This header is crucial for the client to understand how to process the response content.

x-processing-time.description: Represents the time (in milliseconds) taken to process the request on the server side. This can be useful for performance monitoring.
